treatment_plan.definitive: 36 After the root canal treatment of the tooth, the crown was restored. The patient was informed of the course of treatment, related risks and costs, and the patient agreed to the treatment. *35 filling treatments
treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard food, pay attention to oral hygiene, and return to the clinic regularly. Eat and drink after 2 hours.

source_handle: *36 Under local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine 1.7ml *35 Remove all decay, prepare the cavity, blow dry the cavity, apply adhesive, resin filling, light curing, grind the high points of the filling body, and polish.
